overall.instructions: Do the two passages state the same underlying fact, contradict each other, or discuss different facts?

criteria.same_fact: Both passages state the same underlying fact or claim
criteria.contradicts: The passages state opposing facts about the same subject
criteria.different_facts: The passages discuss different subjects or make non-overlapping claims
